verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships its own CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines, on hosted or private runners. It also documents triggering AI-powered automation workflows from the pipeline, so non-interactive automation in CI is directly supported. The evidence does not show a headless interface for driving Bitbucket itself: no documented CLI or API surface for scripting, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. Rovo is mentioned in the terminal, but only as model access, not headless control of Bitbucket. missing for 10: documented headless CLI/API for driving Bitbucket from scripts, non-interactive auth/token docs for CI, independent hands-on corroboration of pipeline-triggered AI workflows

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Trigger AI-powered workflows to automate tedious tasks: clean up feature flags, update docs, draft release notes, fix flaky tests, and more — all from your pipeline.
Run CI/CD workflows across your organization using hosted or private runners—or both
Use our built-in CI/CD tool, Bitbucket Pipelines, to create powerful, automated workflows.
